rows.task_text: Estimate the residential population of individual buildings by combining building-footprint vectors with a gridded population-density raster for an urban district. Both sources must be brought into a common spatial reference. Output: building polygons carrying an estimated-population attribute, plus a district-level summary table.
rows.required_outcome: Building polygons with per-building population estimates + one district summary table.
required_constraints: [EXPLICIT] two inputs: building-footprint vectors, gridded population raster
[EXPLICIT] outputs: populated building layer + district summary
[IMPLICIT] raster values must be related to building footprints through an areal allocation rule
required_capabilities: Areal allocation of raster population to footprints
acceptable_alternatives: Area-proportional allocation of raster totals to building footprints (a total-allocation method that directly estimates building population)
Centroid/point sampling of density values ONLY as a proxy estimate with an explicitly declared footprint-area assumption — conditional route, NOT unconditionally equivalent to allocation
failure_conditions: Sources combined without a common CRS
underdetermined_aspects: Allocation rule choice (area-weight vs centroid) — multiple valid routes
Handling of buildings outside raster coverage
rows.gold_chain_audit: N/A — C-group tasks are freshly drafted; no reference chain exists
rows.authoring: task semantics first; gold derived from task text only

rows.task_text: Compare land-cover maps from two different years of the same classification scheme and produce a change layer distinguishing stable areas, gains, and losses for each class. Report the area of each change type. All outputs must share one spatial grid.
rows.required_outcome: One change layer (stable/gain/loss per class) + per-change-type area table on a common grid.
required_constraints: [EXPLICIT] change layer distinguishing stable/gain/loss per class
[IMPLICIT] class-wise comparison logic (per-class pairing, not just differing pixels)
acceptable_alternatives: Per-class one-hot differencing vs encoded reclass-pair routes
Any grid chosen as reference (stated)
failure_conditions: Areas not reported per change type
Class identity lost in the change encoding
underdetermined_aspects: Change-encoding scheme (pair codes vs separate layers) — multiple valid routes
Resolution harmonization detail if the two maps differ in pixel size

rows.task_text: Derive an elevation profile and mean channel slope for each reach of a river-network vector using a DEM. Reaches must be ordered so upstream/downstream direction is known. Output: reaches carrying profile-derived slope values and a downstream-order identifier.

[EXPLICIT] reaches ordered with known upstream/downstream direction
[IMPLICIT] sampling DEM along the channel, not at arbitrary points
acceptable_alternatives: Densified-vertex sampling vs calibrated transects; any ordering convention stated
underdetermined_aspects: Ordering convention (strahler vs simple flow direction) — multiple valid, must be stated

rows.required_outcome: Three layers in one projected (area-suitable) CRS, geometrically valid, with a per-layer CRS report.
required_constraints: [EXPLICIT] three layers with different source CRS
[EXPLICIT] one target projected CRS suitable for area measurement
[IMPLICIT] validity check must follow transformation, not precede it
acceptable_alternatives: Any area-suitable target CRS (stated)
Any repair strategy (fix vs rebuild)
failure_conditions: Target CRS chosen without area suitability
underdetermined_aspects: Repair strategy detail — multiple valid
Choice among suitable projections

rows.task_text: Reproject a global raster to an equal-area CRS and compute area-weighted global mean and per-continent totals of the raster values — naming the continent-boundary source you use (or explicitly declaring it as a required external input) — so that pixel counts are converted to true areas rather than naive counts.
rows.required_outcome: Equal-area reprojected raster + area-weighted global mean + per-continent totals.
required_constraints: [EXPLICIT] area-weighted global mean (not naive pixel mean)
[EXPLICIT] per-continent totals (continent-boundary source named by the model, or its absence declared as a required external input)
acceptable_alternatives: Compute weights post-reproject vs analytical per-lat weights — both valid if stated
failure_conditions: Naive pixel mean reported as area-weighted
Per-continent totals missing without declaring the continent layer as a required external input
underdetermined_aspects: Continent boundary source (user-supplied layer presumed) — underdetermined input detail
Specific equal-area projection choice
